# Independent R03 → R04 Scoped Review (TTQS 0015 / I02-E05)

## Scope limitations (stated up front)
Text-only review of the supplied R03→R04 diff, the full R04 extracted text, the source packet, and the synthetic register. No tools used, no files touched. SHA values (`b6833138…`, parent `38408239…`, and all packet hashes) are quoted from the packet as given, not independently recomputed. No claims regarding fonts, visuals, REAL status, formal TTQS acceptance, or overall acceptance. The assessment is limited to the four changed hunks: P003, P006, P049, T10 R003.

## Per-change verdicts

| Change | R04 content | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **D4 residual** (primary readers not inside the 30-second block) | P006 heading: 「30 秒使用方式｜供主管、決策者及承辦角色」 | **Resolved** | The blueprint's primary readers (主管與決策者， per `primary_user_or_reader`) plus the 承辦角色 already present in P002 are now embedded in the heading that governs the block itself (P006 → steps P007–P011), not merely in adjacent P002. This closes exactly the flagged gap: the reader statement is part of the 30-second block, not adjacency-only. Consistent with P002 (no contradiction) and with the acceptance test 首頁30秒內說明…讀者. |
| **D5 residue** (P049 supplemental-deadline phrase) | 「本件回覆所列的補充期限」→「實際補件通知明定的期限」 | **Resolved** | The phrase no longer asserts that the reply itself enumerates a supplementary deadline — and the check confirms it never did: the reply (P044–P054) and T10 contain no 補充期限 field (T10 R005 is only 建議寄送期限， a recommended send deadline). The revised phrase attributes the deadline to an external actual supplementary-filing notice, which nothing in the reply/table falsely claims to hold. Consistent with the demonstrated process: T03 R003/R005 (補件中/逾期未回)， P064 §8.1 (補件建議期限， 到期提醒， HOLD), T13 R004 (依實際通知證據), and the conditional-use posture of P025/P043 (建議值須在實案前換成明確日期). No promise that the notice already exists; the draft remains 未寄送 (T10 R002/R006) and speaks in the same real-case voice as P046–P049. |
| **Conditional locator drift** (P076 insertion shifting stored locators) | No change; verified against actual locators | **Cleared** | The concern was whether §9/§6/§11 store locators as P-numbers (which the P076→P077→P078 shift would corrupt). Verified across all locator-bearing content: T15 (register table, R001–R081) uses only §-style locators (§1.3、§2.2、§3.2、§4.3、§5.1、§7.1、§8.1、§8.3、成本計算、全文)； T17 uses §1–§11.1 section locators; the CSV register uses identical section locators; P076 itself cites 第 9 節/第 10 節， which resolve correctly (§9 at P069, §10 at P071) and 「本節來源定位」 correctly to P077. **No P-number locators exist anywhere**, so the renumbering caused zero drift. |
| Version-axis consistency | P003 R03→R04; T10 R003 「與本文件 R04 修訂版次分開」 | **Consistent** | Both axes remain explicitly distinct objects (D3's fix carried forward); P003 and T10 R003 now agree on R04. No residual 「R03」 string anywhere in the R04 text. |

## Contradiction, REAL-invention, and register audit of the changed text
- **No contradictions.** P002 ↔ P006 heading (reader lists identical); P049 revised sentence ↔ P050 (no publish before verification) ↔ P064/T06 R003 (HOLD logic) ↔ T10 R002/R006 (unsent boundary) — all mutually consistent.
- **No invented REAL data.** Every changed line stays within the SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC posture; no date, person, approval, send, or capability fact was introduced.
- **No new unregistered SAMPLE facts.** The reader labels in P006 are document-design role names, not case facts; 「實際補件通知」 in P049 is a conditional forward reference to a process artifact of the same class already used unregistered in T03 R005 and T13 R004 — it has no concrete value requiring a SYN/CTRL key. Register (T15 + CSV, SYN-001–073, CTRL-01–08) remains unmapped-by-change and accurate for all unchanged statistics (70/100, 8÷8, 0÷8 still recompute).

## Remaining issues (all minor, non-blocking)
1. **Recurring maintainability note**: T10 R003 still hard-codes the document revision (now 「R04」); the exact defect the parenthetical guards against re-occurs at every future revision. Cosmetic; no semantic defect at R04.
2. **External-referent dependency**: P049's 「實際補件通知明定的期限」 is not enumerable anywhere inside the reply or tables (no such field exists in T10/T11). Acceptable because no in-document field is asserted and the real-use flow (§2.3, CTRL-05, P025/P043) mandates a concrete-date notice before sending — but worth tracking so the template is never sent without that notice.
3. **Carry-over cosmetics**: P076 remains an unnumbered paragraph (could be 11.3); cited for completeness only.

## Verdict for the changed semantic scope: **PASS**

All four changed hunks are individually sound: D4's residual is now fixed **in-block** (P006 heading, not adjacent P002), the P049 deadline phrase no longer self-referentially dangles and misdirects, the P076-renumbering conditional is cleared by the verified all-section-based locator scheme, and both version-axis references (P003, T10 R003) agree. No contradictions, no fabricated REAL data, and no unregistered SAMPLE case facts were introduced. The three remaining items are maintainability/template-hygiene notes that do not alter meaning, evidence posture, or boundaries. Lineage metadata (`draft_state: UNADOPTED_NOT_REVIEWED`, quoted SHA `b6833138…` vs `38408239…`) remains packet provenance outside the candidate's semantics and outside this verdict.
